deferrals.reason: Latest stable is 3.15, but the sdk-check group's openhands-sdk->litellm->fastuuid chain pins fastuuid 0.14.0 (sdist only, no cp315 wheel) and its bundled PyO3 fails to build on 3.15. pydantic-core has shipped cp315 wheels as of 2.50.1, so fastuuid is the sole blocker — re-check when fastuuid publishes a 3.15-capable release, then promote per the canary policy in docs/operations.md.
